newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steews and heifers were not tested. The last established price was 64.50-65.00 on Friday.

Today's packer bids are 63.00-64.00 with asking prices 66.00- 67.00. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. 29,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,900 formulated and 900 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - None Year Ago - None
